title: Stable consecutive patterns need not be monotone
summary: "A consecutive pattern is stable if and only if it is monotone" is false: 12435 is stable.
source: S. Chen, H. Fang, S. Kitaev, "Stable patterns on permutations of multisets", arXiv:2602.13566v2 (v1 February 2026, v2 1 September 2026), Conjecture 6.1.
label: lean
